type Options = {
  logging: { enabled: boolean };
  reason: string;
};
export async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: Options) {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
const saved: number[] = [];
inOrder([1, 2, 3], async item => { saved.push(item); }, {
  logging: { enabled: false },
  reason: 'Each update reads the prior result'
}).then(() => {
  if (saved.join(',') !== '1,2,3') throw new Error(String(saved));
  console.log('saved=' + saved);
});
